name: register_dnc_optout
description: Registers the caller's phone number to the Do-Not-Call (DNC) list. Invoke immediately upon verbal opt-out.

headers.X-DNC-Secret: <set in Retell and in the n8n Header Auth credential, never committed>

phone_number.description: The E.164 formatted number of the caller to register (e.g. +14155552671).

optout_reason.description: The specific phrase or context matching the opt-out statement.
